bla ma dang lhag ma'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje srid gsum kun khyab can/ /nyin byed bye ba'i gzi brjid 'phrog byed cing / /rgyal sras tshogs kyis mchog tu rab bstod pa/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog la gus phyag 'tshal/ /nyi ma'i drung du zla bas bgrod pa bzhin/ /dgra ngan dpung tshogs ma lus zil gyis gnon/ /rgya mtsho'i klong gnas klu mchog ma lus pa/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis thal sbyar rab tu 'dud/ /in+d+ra ni la'i mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'bar/ /thun mtshams sprin gyi mdog can bla gos 'dzin/ /chos sgrog phyag rgya mi phyed thugs kar bcings/ /rab mdzes gtsug na klu mgo'i gdengs ka can/ /sngo sangs nam mkha'i mdog can 'dab brgya pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i dbus na mdzes/ /ku mud mdangs ldan sgrib pa rnam sel ba/ /rin chen myu gu yid 'ong bum pa rnams/ /dmar ba'i 'od chags mi pham byams pa yis/ /klu shing me tog ril ba spyi blug dang / /'jam dbyangs gser 'od rab tu 'bar ba can/ /glegs bam ral gri yongs su 'dzin par mdzad/ /thugs rje chen po dmar 'od me tog 'dzin/ /'khor tshogs dpag med dbus na mngon mtho ba/ /mtha' yas zhing khams byin rlabs 'od zer 'gyed/ /tshul bzang yongs su rdzogs pa klu dbang la/ /gus pas bstod pa'i dge tshogs gang thob pa/ /dus gsum pha ma dang bcas 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur thob shog /ces sangs rgyas klu dbang la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor mtshan dpe'i phung po ni/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor shes bya ma lus mkhyen/ /rgyal ba kun la dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/

/tshad med yon tan 'od kyi snang ba yis/ /khams gsum mun pa ma lus rab bsal te/ /sna tshogs gdul bya yang dag lam la 'god/ /khyab bdag thugs rje'i nyi ma la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas chen po las/ /'gro ba thar pa'i gling du 'dren mdzad pa/ /skyob pa bla med ded dpon mchog gyur cing / /spros pa nyer zhi zhi ba'i thabs la mkhas/ /ma 'dres yon tan mkha' ltar rnam dag cing / /rdul gcig yul la rab 'byams 'jig rten kun/ /ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / /mtha' yas 'gro la gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor ston/ /rab tu phra rdul rags par mi 'gyur zhing / /'jig rten phra bar mi 'gyur bsam mi khyab/ /skye 'chi spangs kyang skye ba sna tshogs ston/ /'dzin pa med kyang gdul bya rjes su 'dzin/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid yin yang bdud dpung 'joms/ /spros pa med kyang dam chos spros pa ston/ /khyod ni cung zad dran pas byang chub tu/ /nges par mdzad pa'i phrin las bla na med/ /rgyal ba kun la bstod pa'i me tog gi/ /phreng ba rab tu spel ba'i dge tshogs kyis/ /'gro kun sa lam rim pa legs bgrod nas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra rnam par rgyal ba'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /sangs rgyas rabs bdun la bstod pa chos kyi rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa las/ /skyob par mdzad pa tshad med thugs rje can/ /stobs bzhi'i stobs kyis bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs kun/ /ma lus 'joms mdzad 'dren pa bla na med/ /sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs dang mar me mdzad/ /rin chen gtsug tor can sogs sngon byung gi/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dad pa'i gtsug gis ni/ /rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub 'od srung dang / /skyob pa'i dbang po shākya'i rgyal po ste/

/dpal ldan sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la ni/ /rtag par gus pas yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bla med thar pa'i gnas su 'dren gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos nā len+d+rar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'chi med rnga sgra la bstod pa 'chi med mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs bcu'i stobs ldan 'chi med go 'phang brnyes/ /dam chos 'chi med rnga sgra snyan pa'i gsung / /mtha' yas zhing gi khyon ltar yangs pa'i thugs/ /gdul bya kun la 'chi med bdud rtsi 'gyed/ /'chi bdag bdud las skyob mdzad de bzhin gshegs/ /gzi brjid 'od kyis khams gsum mun pa sel/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i gnyen du gyur pa'i mchog /mchog gi dngos grub yongs su ster ba dang / /'jig rten kun gyis sgron me mchog tu gnas/ /pad+mo'i mtsho la nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du/ /blo gros pad+mo kun nas rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /'chi bdag mun pa ring du spong mdzad la/ /mchog tu gus pas phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /dge 'dis 'chi bdag bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /'chi med dngos grub myur du thob gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po kha sar pa ṇi la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi char sprin zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis 'o ma'i chu char bsrubs pa las/ /legs par 'thon pa sku yi ri bong can/ /mtha' yas zhing gi ston zla'i 'od tshogs kun/ /ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i 'od 'phro zhing / /pad zla'i steng du skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs/ /thugs rje'i zhags pas 'gro rnams srid mtsho las/ /'dren par mdzad pa'i phrin las bla na med/ /phyag g.yas 'o ma'i chu rgyun 'bab pa las/ /sdug bsngal khur gyi ngal ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /yongs su tshim par mdzad pa skyob pa'i dbang /

/sgrib gnyis dri ma ma lus rab spangs pas/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na me tog dkar po 'dzin/ /sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /'jig rten lha brgyas bstod dbyangs rab sgrog cing / /bla na med pa'i mchod sprin phung pos mchod/ /nyams thag 'gro ba rjes 'dzin mchog tu bsngags/ /tshad med thugs rjes khams gsum ma lus khyab/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa'i bye brag ma lus pa/ /mngon sum mkhyen nas 'dul ba'i thabs mang gis/ /sdug bsngal khur gyis ngal ba'i sems can rnams/ /bla med thar pa'i lam du 'dren mdzad pa/ /rje btsun kha sar pa ṇi che mchog la/ /bstod tshig char sprin phreng bas mchod par bgyi/ /gang la bstod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba rnams/ /thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /mgon po tshe dpag med la bstod pa 'chi med rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab mdzes dmar ba'i 'od can 'dab stong steng / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pa'i dbus/ /mnyam pa'i stabs kyis gyen du bzhengs pa'i sku/ /pad+ma ra ga'i mdog can 'od stong ldan/ /'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed snod/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol ba'i dbus na 'dzin/ /'chi med bdud rtsi ster ba lhag pa'i lha/ /dmar ba'i 'od kyis khor yug dbus na mdzes/ /dbu skra'i cod pan lan bu rting par non/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus bzlog mdzad pa/ /nyams thag sdug bsngal gyur pa kun gyi skyabs/ /rgyal ba tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi med dngos grub stsol ba'i tshe dpag med/ /gus pas bstod pa'i dge ba gang thob pa/ /'chi bdag bdud las rnam par rgyal gyur te/ /'od dpag med pa'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces tshe dpag med la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /mkha' 'gro ma sme brtsegs la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs zhes bya ba/

bla ma dang dpal ldan mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byin rlabs kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /dngos grub ma lus ster mdzad pa/ /dag byed bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gtso bor 'dud/ /mun pa'i mdog can pad+ma'i steng / /nyin byed dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i dbus/ /zhabs zung mnyam pa'i 'dug stangs can/ /gzi brjid rab 'bar gyen du bzhengs/ /mun nag char sprin mdog can ma/ /dbu skra dmar ser thun mtshams sprin/ /spyan gsum dmar 'od glog phreng bzhin/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin/ /ma dag dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /mi rtog ting 'dzin g.yo ba med/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i dpal/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro ma la 'dud/ /thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i dbus/ /hūm̐ yig mthing nag las byung bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /lus ngag yid kyi dri ma kun sel ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma la gus pas bstod par bgyi/ /bstod pa'i dge tshogs dri med pas/ /ma dag dri ma dag gyur cig /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dngos grub ma lus thob gyur cig /ces rong stong chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /mkha' spyod dkar mo la bstod pa byin rlabs rnam rol zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten lha brgya'i gtsug gis rab mchod cing / /bde stong ting 'dzin stobs kyi dbang po rgyas/ /pad zla'i steng na yid 'ong 'ja' tshon sku/ /rigs lnga'i thod phreng 'du byed lnga bcu dag /yongs su dag pa'i 'od phreng rgyan du byas/ /zhing khams rgya mtshor rnam par 'phro ba'i 'od/ /khams gsum mun pa ma lus sel mdzad cing / /dpag med rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis rnam par rol/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i rig 'dzin mchog gnas su/ /'gro ba 'dren mdzad phrin las bla na med/ /gri thod zung gi rgyan gyis phyag gnyis mdzes/ /sdug bsngal kun skyob brtse ba'i bdag nyid can/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog dpal mo bde chen gnas/

/dad pa'i me tog phreng ba gus pas bstod/ /bstod pa'i dge tshogs gang zhig thob pa des/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su bgrod par shog /ces rong ston chen pos nā len+d+rar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /mkha' spyod dkar mo la bstod pa rin chen rgyan phreng zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad zla'i dbus na hrīḥyig las byung ma/ /nyon mongs gdung sel rab dkar zla 'od can/ /phyin drug rdzogs pa'i rgyan phreng 'od 'bar zhing / /nyon mongs rab bsreg me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /lang tsho rab mdzes shin tu yid 'ong ma/ /bcu drug lo lon tshul gyis gzi mdangs can/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos dkar ba'i sku/ /gos bzang rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par spras/ /ma rig gnyid kyis non pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /sad phyir sgra stong hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgra sgrogs/ /bde stong zung 'jug dbyer med lhan cig skyes/ /dmar mo spyan gsum mkha' la rab gzigs ma/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams ni legs mchod cing / /du ba 'khyil ba'i dbu skra sil bur 'chang / /thabs shes gnyis med rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /mtshon cha'i mchog ni mchan khung g.yon na mdzes/ /dug gsum ljon pa rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ /phyag g.yas gri gug mkha' la rab 'dzin cing / /gnyis med bdud rtsi rnam par rol pa'i phyir/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis thod pa yongs su 'dzin/ /'gro la rab dgyes zhal ni 'dzum khror bcas/ /chos nyid 'gyur med dbu skra bung ba'i mdog /rigs lnga'i thod pas dbu la rab brgyan zhing / /rnam rtog rab spangs brgya phyed thod phreng can/ /sgyu ma'i don rtogs 'ja' tshon gur khyim dbus/ /gzi brjid phung po ri dbang lhun po bzhin/ /'gro ba mkha' spyod gnas su 'dren mdzad ma/ /bcom ldan lha mo'i gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang sku yid 'ong yid la sems pa dang / /gsung gi rig sngags cung zad bzla byed pa/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'dren pa dang /

/bstod tshig brjod pa dag kyang skal bar ldan/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar mdzes pa'i 'dzum zhal can/ /legs par bzhugs nas byin rlabs mthu stobs kyis/ /rig 'dzin mkha' spyod dbyings su drangs mdzod cig /tshe 'dir thos bsam sgom pa 'phel bar mdzod/ /khyed la bstod pa'i dge tshogs gang thob pas/ /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal ma lus rab zhi zhing / /mtho ris yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang / /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'dren par shog /ces slar yang rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /mkha' spyod dmar mo la bstod pa snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad med yon tan 'od kyi drwa ba can/ /pad zla'i steng na cung zad 'gying ba'i tshul/ /byi ru'i mdangs 'phrog thun mtshams sprin gyis 'od/ /lang tsho rab rgyas sgeg pa'i tshul 'chang ma/ /dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan gsum dmar 'od can/ /yongs su dag pa'i mkha' la rab tu gzigs/ /'jig rten lha brgyas zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /gus pas rab 'dud bcom ldan ma la bstod/ /tshul bzang yongs su rdzogs pa gang gi sku/ /ka la ping ka'i dbyangs kyi sgra ldan dang / /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs mnga' zhing / /dpag yas yon tan zag med bde chen gnas/ /srid pa'i 'jigs gnas 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'dren pa'i 'phrin las ma/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs nas thugs rje yis/ /'od zer kun nas 'phro bar mdzad du gsol/ /dmar ba'i mdog can mkha' spyod ma bstod pa'i/ /dge tshogs tshad med gang dag thob pa las/ /sdug bsngal rab 'das dag pa mkha' spyod gnas/ /'gro kun bde blag nyid du bsgrod par shog /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma la bstod pa byin rlabs myur mgyogs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/tshad med 'gro la thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes rab rgyas te/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyi mkha' la rab 'gro ma/ /yon tan brjod las 'das kyang cung zad bsgrags/ /man ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dri ma kun/ /rab tu dag byed dpa' ba'i blo ldan ma/ /skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal kun las skyob mdzad pa'i/ /phul byung las kyang ches cher phul du byung / /gsung gi rnga sgra rnam par reg pa las/ /yid kyi chu mtshor rtogs pa'i rlabs g.yo zhing / /mi rtog ting 'dzin nyi ma'i snying po dang / /lhan skyes bde ba'i 'od zer mnyam du rgyas/ /lhag par zhing 'dir gsung zer rab 'phros pas/ /gdul bya du mas rmad byung rtogs pa thob/ /'phrin las bzang po mi zad 'byung ba'i gter/ /dran pa tsam gyis byin rlabs 'jug la 'dud/ /khyod la bstod pa'i bsod nams phun tshogs kyis/ /thar pa'i lam dang ting 'dzin thob gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+rar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /rdo rje phag mo la bstod pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa'i sa thob cing / /zag med bde chen rjes chags byi ru'i mdog /thabs dang shes rab zung du sbrel ba yis/ /gri thod bsnol bas thugs kar rnam par brgyan/ /stong nyid don rtogs sku gsum 'bras bu can/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni gru mor gyen phyogs shing / /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lha brnyes pas/ /rigs lnga'i cod pan gtsug na rnam par mdzes/ /'du byed lnga bcu dri med yongs dag pas/ /mi mgo'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba dang / /nyon mongs bud shing mtha' dag rab bsreg phyir/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus na gnas/ /mchog gi dngos grub kun ster bcom ldan ma/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'chi med bdud rtsi thob/ /rgyal ba mchod byed rnam dag sku 'dzin mas/ /sa yi khyon 'dir dgyes pa'i gar stabs bsgyur/

/gang la mchod byed skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa las/ /grol bar mdzad pa rmad byung lhag pa'i lha/ /dpal ldan phag mo'i sku gsung thugs mchog la/ /rab tu dad pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /byin rlabs gter mdzod rdo rje phag mo la/ /bstod pa'i dge bas 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las/ /grol nas mchog gi dngos grub thob pa dang / /kun kyang lha mo'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces rong ston chen pos shrī nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la bstod pa byin rlabs gter zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes yon tan mi zad gter/ /mtha' yas 'gro la brtse ba'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /rmad byung 'phrin las kun 'dus bstod par bgyi/ /'dab stong steng na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /nyin byed 'bum gyi gzi brjid 'phrog byed cing / /'phrin las bzhi yi bdag nyid yid 'ong sku/ /stobs bcu'i stobs kyi bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs gnon/ /dregs ldan kun gyi zhabs pad brtan pa'i dpal/ /zhal gsum phyag drug ut+pal mthing ka'i mdog /g.yas zhal dkar po g.yon pa dmar ba'i mdog /phyag g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma 'dzin/ /phyag g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri dang / /thugs ka'i pad+mo dmar ba'i 'od ldan pa/ /ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar yang / /ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ yig 'od dang bcas/ /spyan gsum glog 'od drag po rnam g.yo zhing / /sku yi dkyil 'khor 'ja' 'od gur khyim dang / /mtshams dkar rin chen phreng ba kun da'i mdog /mtha' yas zhing kun khyab pa'i 'od zer can/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur la phyag 'tshal/ /shes bya ma lus rnam par snang mdzad cing / /gser 'od 'khyug pa rin chen kun gyi gter/ /dmar ba'i 'od chags 'dzin pa snang mtha' yas/ /don kun grub mdzad rigs kyi lha bzhi rgyal/

/rab mdzes 'ja' tshon sku can rigs kyi yum/ /sdug bsngal nyer zhi'i phrin las bsgrub mdzad pa/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rab tu mchod par byed la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag bsam dri med kun la rab 'jug cing / /gzhan don khur gyis mi ngal srid mtha'i bar/ /don gnyis bsgrub la g.yel ba med 'jug pa/ /rnam dag thugs mnga' rgyal sras rnams la 'dud/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can spyan gsum dmar ba'i 'od/ /zad pa'i dus kyi me chen rab 'bar ba/ /sna tshogs gzugs can klu dbang rgyan du byas/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bstod pa'i dge tshogs gang zhig thob pa des/ /mthong ba'i chos la bden don mthong ba dang / /sgrib gnyis mun pa'i dpung las rgyal gyur cig /byang chub nye lam myur ba'i dngos grub brnyes/ /bde blag nyid du rtsol bar mdzad nas kyang / /phyogs rnams kun tu bde legs khyab pa dang / /bkra shis phun tshogs rnam par rgyal gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dam par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lor 'khod pa'i khro bo bcu la bstod pa rngam pa sgra sgrogs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang khro bo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro la brtse ba can/ /kun la byams pa 'dor ba med gyur kyang / /gdul bya 'dul phyir 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dab stong dbus na nyin byed bkod pa'i steng / /gzi brjid rab 'bar gar gyi stangs stabs can/ /me lce'i gur khyim 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /sgeg cing dpa' ba'i tshul gyis rnam par bzhugs/ /spyan gsum dmar ba glog ltar rab 'khyug pas/ /bdud kyi dpung tshogs mtha' yas 'jigs byed cing / /kun gyi dbus na ri dbang lhun po bzhin/

/phyogs rnams du mar 'jigs pa'i 'od zer 'phro/ /char sprin khrod na glog phreng rgyu ba ltar/ /drag po'i ljags bskyod sna tshogs skrag byed cing / /'jigs rung mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa dang / /stobs bcu'i stobs kyis bdud dpung 'joms par mdzad/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bskyod pa'i 'od/ /rab brjid nyi ma'i 'od kyang pham byed pa/ /sku'i cha shas cung zad bskyod pas kyang / /ma lus 'jig rten khams kun g.yo bar 'gyur/ /dbugs rlung 'phro bas lhun po'ang 'jigs byed cing / /bskal pa'i me chen drag tu 'bar ba yang / /zhal nas dbugs gcig btab pas zhi mdzad pa'i/ /dpa' chen dpa' bo dpal ldan 'jigs su rung / /zhabs kyi gom pa rab tu bskyod pa las/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can skrag pas 'dar ba bzhin/ /gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor yid la bkod tsam gyis/ /nyer 'tshe'i 'jigs pa gang dag zhi bar 'gyur/ /bzhad pa'i nga ros stong gsum 'brug sgra yang / /mtha' yas zil gyis gnon pa'i sgra dbyangs can/ /rnam dag thugs kyis ma lus mkhyen pa dang / /'jigs pa kun skyob khro bo'i tshogs la bstod/ /bstod pa'i dge tshogs gaṅgā'i chu rgyun gyis/ /yid kyi dri ma ma lus dag gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rigs bzhi'i lha mo rdo rje ma lnga la bstod pa rin chen rgyan phreng zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lha mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zag med bdud rtsis dbang po rab rgyas shing / /dga' bde'i dpal gyis rnam par rol pa can/ /tshad med bzhi yis 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa phul du byung / /rigs bzhi'i 'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal/ /bgegs rnams rab 'jigs yams nad zhi ba dang / /tshad med gdul bya yongs su sdud mdzad cing / /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las skyob lhag pa'i lha/ /yid 'ong mchod sprin rnam par mdzes pa las/

/ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid dag pa'i lha/ /rgyal ba kun mchod 'dod yon sprin tshogs kyis/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab par mdzad pa mo/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku can sku lnga yis/ /ye shes lnga ldan lha mo'i lha tshogs kyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo sor mo'i 'dab phreng can/ /dad pa'i blo can bdag gis spyi bos 'dud/ /bstod pa'i dbyangs snyan yongs su spel ba las/ /dge tshogs gang zhig thob pa de yis ni/ /lhag pa'i lha tshogs rab tu mnyes gyur te/ /rmad byung byin rlabs yid la 'jug gyur cig /ces pa 'di rong ston chen pos nā len+d+rar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi char rgyun rnam par g.yo ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla med rgyud sde snying po'i don gyi lha/ /byin rlabs 'od stong rnam par 'gyed pa dang / /phrin las bzhi yis rigs bzhi'i don mdzad pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyob pa bla na med/ /rnam par thar brgyad dag pa'i zhal mnga' zhing / /bcu phrag gnyis dang chu gter spyan yangs mdzes/ /char sprin mdangs 'phrog mun pa'i mdangs can de/ /sngo dkar dmar dang dud kha'i zhal ni mdzes/ /tshangs dbang nye dbang drag po bsnol ba'i steng / /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyen du mngon 'phags shing / /zhabs kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rnam bkod pa/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /stong nyid bcu drug rnam par dag pa'i phyag /g.yas g.yon phyogs su rnam par rgyal gyur te/ /mi zad bdud kyi dpa' bo 'ching byed cing / /rin chen rus phreng sogs kyis rnam par brgyan/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid skur gyur pa/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med yum dang bcas/ /dngos kun rang bzhin mchog tu gdod nas dag /'gro kun skyon kun skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje la/ /cha tsam bstod pa'i dge ba yis/

/mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis/ /bla med go 'phang myur thob shog /ces dgyes pa rdo rje la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po la bstod pa rnam par rol pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ bla med gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i rol pa kun tu mi gtong zhing / /zhi ba'i thugs mnga' mi g.yo gnas gyur kyang / /gdul bya'i don du khros pa'i skur ston pa/ /'jigs mdzad gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub mchog gnas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa/ /kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i stobs ldan pas/ /bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms mdzad cing / /ma he'i gdan la zhabs kyi dkyil 'khor bkod/ /byi ru'i mdangs 'phrog gzi brjid phung po can/ /dmar ba'i 'od ldan spyan gsum glog phreng g.yo/ /phyag g.yas rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyug pa dkar/ /phrag pa'i steng na 'phyar ba'i tshul can rgyal/ /g.yon pa thugs khar thod pa'i snod 'dzin cing / /me chen 'bar ba'i khrod na rab 'gying ba/ /nyon mongs dug lnga dag pa'i sku mnga' can/ /ye shes lnga ldan sku lnga mchog la 'dud/ /gang la bstod pa'i dge tshogs dri med pas/ /kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i sku thob cing / /mdzad pa phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /bla med byang chub myur du thob par shog /ces rong ston chen pos nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la bstod pa 'jigs pa'i sgra sgrogs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs khros pa'i tshul gyis skur ston pa/ /'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing / /nag phyogs bdud kyi dpung tshogs bcas pa kun/ /ma lus mthar byed mthu stobs can la 'dud/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / /rnam mang dbu la re re'i spyan gsum dmar/

/rnam dag phyag na 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha can/ /ma he'i gdan la 'jigs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ /mi 'jigs dpung tshogs rgyas pa'i me 'od kyis/ /srid pa'i mun nag ma lus rnam sel zhing / /'gro kun dbugs 'byin mdzad pa'i phrin las can/ /rdzu 'phrul zhabs ldan khro bo'i rgyal por 'dud/ /yon tan mi zad mchog tu gyur pa'i lha/ /'jam dbyangs khros pa'i tshul ston gzugs kyi sku/ /bdud dpung ma lus rnam par 'jigs byed pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang la gus pas bstod pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams kun las rgyal gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o/ /shu bhaṃ// ༈ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la bstod pa byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid 'ong mtshan dpe rab ldan gzi brjid 'bar/ /zag med bde chen mchog gis gang ba pa/ /las bzhi'i dbang byed sku bzhi'i zhal mnga' zhing / /mthing ka ljang dang dmar ser zhal kyi mdog /khro 'dzum dkyil 'khor re re'ang spyan gsum 'bar/ /bcu gnyis dag pa'i phyag gis rab mdzes shing / /thabs shes zung gis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol/ /gti mug rab spangs glang chen lpags pa 'dzin/ /legs par 'doms pa'i sgra dbyangs ḍā ma ru/ /srid rtsa gcod pa'i dgra satwa gri gug dang / /dug gsum rab 'joms rtse gsum g.yas nas bsnams/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ka dang thod pa zhags pa dang / /tshangs pa'i mgo bo g.yon pa'i phyag mdzes shing / /in+d+ra ni la'i phung po brtsegs pa'i sku/ /nyin mor byed pa'i gzi brjid 'phrog byed cing / /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /myur ba'i mkhyen pas ma lus cig car mkhyen/ /myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul dpag med ston mdzad cing / /myur ba'i mngon shes rnam dag skyon bral ba/ /myur ba'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzad la 'dud/

/lhag pa'i lha mchog bstod pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /lus can ma lus srid mtsho las bsgral nas/ /dpag yas yon tan kun gyis rab mdzes pa/ /bla med thar pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bde mchog gi 'khor lo bzhi'i lha tshogs la bstod pa bdud rtsi'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor rdzu 'phrul dpag med kyis/ /mtha' yas zhing gi gdul bya smin mdzad cing / /gsung gi dkyil 'khor yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs/ /dam chos bdud rtsis 'gro la khyab par mdzad/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' bral mngon gyur nas/ /ma lus mngon sum mkhyen par mdzad pa yis/ /dam tshig 'khor lo gnas pa'i lha tshogs kyi/ /rmad byung dngos grub sbyin par mdzad la 'dud/ /dga' bde mi zad sbyin pa'i gter mnga' ba/ /bde mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bstod pa'i/ /dge tshogs gang zhig thob pa de dag gis/ /tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub mchog thob shog /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i bstod pa snying po mchog ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i rnam par rol pa'i sku/ /snying po las kyang snying po mchog gyur pa/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams kun gyi mchog gyur gnas/ /'phrin las bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad la 'dud/ /rigs bzhi'i gdul bya yongs su smin pa dang / /zag med bde ba'i dga' ston 'gyed pa'i gter/ /'gro la phan pa'i phrin las rab stsol ba/ /tshad med yon tan dag gis spras la 'dud/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams gus pas rab bstod pa'i/ /dge bas rnal 'byor ma tshogs 'grub gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos shrī nā len+d+rar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /'jam dbyangs smra seng la bstod pa shes rab kyi gter mdzod ces bya ba/

bla ma dang 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngag gi dbang phyug lta ngan 'joms mdzad pa/ /smra ba'i seng ge mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid can/ /yan lag drug cu gsung gi sgra dbyangs kyis/ /phas rgol log rtog kun 'joms khyod la 'dud/ /thugs kyi char sprin mkhyen rab glog 'od 'khyug /ma rig mun pa ring du spong ba dang / /ngag gi spobs pa 'byin mdzad lhag pa'i lha/ /smra ba'i seng ge 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud/ /gang sku yid 'ong yid la sems byed cing / /ngag gis rigs sngags dag kyang bzla byed pa/ /spobs pa mi zad yongs su ster ba'i mdzod/ /gur gum mdog can 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud/ /khams gsum kun la rgyal ba'i stobs mnga' ba/ /gdong lnga'i steng na rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /zur phud lnga ldan rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /chos sgrogs phyag rgyas thugs khar mtshan la 'dud/ /gang la cung zad bstod pas 'gro ba kun/ /lhag pa'i shes rab rnam par rgyas gyur cig /ces 'jam dbyangs smra seng la bstod la rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo mgon po la bstod pa spobs pa mi zad 'byung ba'i gter zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor gzi brjid 'od stong ldan/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor dpag med seng ge'i sgra/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor mi 'jigs spobs pa brnyes/ /bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dab stong dbus na nyin byed dkyil 'khor dag /rnam par bkod pa'i dbus na lhun po bzhin/ /gyad kyi dpa' bo rol pa'i stangs stabs kyis/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na rab tu bzhugs/ /mtha' yas zhing gi nyin byed dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'od stong ma lus bsdus pa'i gzi brjid can/ /char sprin dbus na glog phreng 'gyu ba ltar/ /mtha' yas zhing gi nyin byed dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'od stong ma lus bsdus pa'i gzi brjid can/

/char sprin dbus na glog phreng 'gyu ba ltar/ /dmar ba'i ljags bskyod sna tshogs 'jigs pa ston/ /dbugs rlung rnam par 'phro bas lhun po yang / /rab tu 'jig cing rdul phran ltar mdzad de/ /zhabs kyi gom pa bskyod pas rab 'byams zhing / /rgya mtsho'i gos can skrag pas 'dar ba snyam/ /zad pa'i dus kyi me chen 'bar ba yang / /zhal gyi dbugs gcig btab pas 'jil ba dang / /yangs pa'i lto bar 'jig rten kun rdzogs shing / /char sprin stug po 'thibs ltar rngam pa'i gzugs/ /dus gsum gzigs pa spyan gsum dmar ba yi/ /khor yug bkod pas bdud dpung skrag mdzad cing / /phyag g.yas ral gri me lce 'bar ba'i 'od/ /'jig rten ma lus yongs su snang bar byed/ /sdigs mdzub rdo rjer bcas pas 'jig rten gyis/ /sa gzhi'i khyon rnams ma lus 'ching byed cing / /mi zad bdud sde'i dpung gis phyag byas pa/ /ba spu re las khro rgyal sprul pa 'gyed/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor yid la sems pa dang / /ngag gi rigs sngags rgyal po bzla byed pa/ /spobs pa mi zad stsol pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /rab brjid khro bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog mi g.yo mgon po la/ /bstod pa'i dge tshogs gang zhig grub pa des/ /mkhyen pa'i 'od stong rab tu 'bar ba las/ /khams gsum mun pa ma lus sel gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo dkar po la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das kun rig la bstod pa ye shes kyi snang ba kun tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i gangs ri kun nas mngon mtho zhing / /brtse ba'i chu rgyun dri med rab rgyas pas/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dri ma kun sel ba/ /tshad med rig pa thugs rje can la 'dud/ /pad dkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i dbus/ /rdo rje skyil krung mi g.yo brtan bzhugs nas/

/ting 'dzin phyag rgya yongs su 'ching mdzad cing / /rab dkar ku mud zla ba'i 'od dang ldan/ /mdzod spu'i 'od kyis khams gsum snang byas te/ /'gro kun ngan song sdug bsngal mun pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus zhi mdzad tshad med thugs rje can/ /sbyong ba'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /ngan song khur gyis ngal ba'i lus can rnams/ /bla med thar pa'i lam du 'dren mdzad pa/ /zla zer mngon par mtho ba'i gangs ri bzhin/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus na mngon par mtho/ /chos dbyings mkha' ltar snang ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /nyon mongs rgya mtshor bying ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal nyer zhi zhi ba'i sar 'god pa/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam dag skur dmigs nas/ /rig sngags rgyal po bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang / /khams gsum sdug bsngal ma lus zhi byed pa'i/ /bcom ldan kun rig 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /gang la gus pas bstod pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /ma lus 'gro bas kun rig thob gyur nas/ /ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stongs pa dang / /bdag gi smon lam ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das kun rig la bstod pa rong ston chen pos nā len+d+rar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa la bstod pa 'chi med rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis 'o ma'i chu bo bsrubs pa las/ /legs par 'thon pa zla 'od 'phro ba'i sku/ /yid 'ong 'ja' tshon gur khyim bkod pa'i dbus/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis reg pa'i gangs ri bzhin/ /phyag na mi phyed rdo rje rab 'bar bas/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi dpung tshogs 'joms pa dang / /mi 'jigs sbyin pa skyabs sbyin phyag rgya yis/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal skyob par mdzad/ /sems can kun gyi mgon du gyur na'ang / /me tog mda' can dpung tshogs pham mdzad de/ /mu mtha' bral ba'i mtha' yas thugs rje yis/

/zhing rdul grangs mnyam 'gro la 'od stong 'gyed/ /gang gi mdun phyogs lha yi gus pas 'dud/ /gdengs can dbang pos rgya mtsho'i mchod yon dang / /lha bu gzhon nus sprin dkar gdugs 'dzin sogs/ /rab snyan lha mi'i mchod pa phul byung brnyes/ /yid 'ong sku yi dkyil 'khor mdzes pa la/ /rgyu skar dbang po ngo mtshar ldan pa'i blos/ /skar tshogs du ma'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /rab tu bskul nas gling 'dir 'ongs pa bzhin/ /nyin mor byed pa'ang 'gran zla 'tshol phyir du/ /gling bzhi kun tu yang yang rgyu na yang / /'gran zla ma mthong shin tu ngal gyur pas/ /nub kyi phyogs su 'bros par rtsom pa na/ /'chi bdag bdud las rgyal ba'i phrin las kyis/ /mtha' yas zhing du dam chos zlos gar bsgyur/ /gsung dbyangs 'chi med rnga sgra'i dpal 'phrog cing / /rnam dag thugs ni mkha' ltar yangs la 'dud/ /'chi bdag bdud 'joms lhag pa'i lha tshogs la/ /bstod tshig me tog snyim pas gus mchod pas/ /lha mi'i bde ba phun tshogs ldan gyur pa/ /'chi bdag bdud las rnam par rgyal gyur cig /phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /kun tu bzang po la bstod pa dga' ba'i me tog kun nas rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu dga' ba'i 'od zer phreng ba yis/ /srid pa'i mun pa ring du spong mdzad cing / /ma smad yid 'ong bzang po'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /kun bzang bla ma lha yi lha la 'dud/ /gangs ri'i ngos la zla 'od g.yo ba ltar/ /rab dkar dri med 'od stong rgyas pa'i mdangs/ /phyogs bcur 'phros pas mtha' yas 'gro kun gyis/ /mi shes mun pa ring du spong bar mdzad/ /ma dros mtsho la chu klung 'bab pa bzhin/ /byin rlabs chu rgyun phyogs bral rab tu g.yo/ /nyin byed dbang po 'od ris g.yo ba las/ /ku mud mdzes kyang zum nas thon ma nus/

/pha rol yid dga' 'dzum zer me tog gi /'dab ma'i rtse la chu yi thigs pa dag /rlung gis rab tu bskyod pas lhung ba ltar/ /thugs rje'i zeg mas rab tu g.yo ba byed/ /mya ngan med pa'i shing gi me tog bzhin/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i ge sar 'dzum mdangs can/ /sgrib gnyis dri med sel ba'i dri zhim dang / /phun tshogs yon tan dpag med mnyam du rgyas/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin mdzad pa la/ /kun tu phrin las bzang po'i 'od zer dag /rnam par 'phro bas kun sbyor mun pa rnams/ /ring du spangs pa'i ye shes snang ba can/ /lha dang lha min spyi bor thal sbyar nas/ /skyabs gsum zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud pa dang / /zhi 'od chags pas pha rol yid dga' zhing / /dkar po'i yon tan cha shas ma lus rdzogs/ /skyabs med rnams kyis skyob pa'i mgon gyur pa/ /dran pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal rab zhi zhing / /brtse ba'i bdag nyid 'dren pa'i gtsor gyur pa/ /yid 'ong mtshan dpe'i me tog rnam par rgyas/ /gzhan don lhur len nyams thag skye bo la/ /thugs rje'i 'od dkar kun nas 'phro mdzad pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i zhabs pad dri med la/ /rab tu gus pas yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bstod tshig me tog phreng bas mchod pa las/ /dge tshogs grub pa gang des 'gro ba kun/ /skyob pa bla med go 'phang myur thob cing / /kun bzang smon lam ji bzhin 'grub par shog /ces kun tu bzang po la bstod pa rong ston chen pos sbyar ba'o// ༈ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel la bstod pa ye shes kyi snang ba kun nas rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten lha brgya'i gtsug gis rab mchod cing / /'od zer rab rgyas 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku/ /rab snyan gsung ni lha yi rgyud mangs ltar/ /rnam par mdzes pa'i dga' ston 'gyed par mdzad/ /shes bya ma lus mngon sum mkhyen pa yis/ /chos kun ma 'dres so sor rnam 'byed kyang /

/ro mnyam nyid du yang dag thugs chud cing / /mtha' yas zhing du sku yi rdzu 'phrul 'gyed/ /sa yi mthar thugs spangs rtogs kun brnyes shing / /ye shes 'od kyi snang ba rab rgyas pas/ /dpag yas gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro rnams kyi/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa ma lus rnam par sel/ /chos rnams dmigs su med kyang chos kun ston/ /bden med rtogs kyang bden pa ston par mdzad/ /'bad rtsol med kyang phrin las sna tshogs bsgrubs/ /kun sbyor 'ching ba bdud kyi dpa' bo 'ching / /sgrib pa rnam sel brtse ba'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba kun la phan bde'i mchog stsol ba/ /skyabs med rnams kyi skyob pa mchog la ni/ /rab tu dang bas yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel la/ /bstod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /sgrib pa ma lus rnam par sel gyur cig /sgrib bral chos sku'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /sgrol ma u gra tā ra la bstod pa spobs pa mi zad pa'i gter zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid 'ong pad+ma'i gdan mchog bkod pa'i dbus/ /sems bral gzugs kyi bkod pa gnas pa'i steng / /gzi brjid phung po blta bar mi bzod pa/ /char sprin mdangs 'phrog drag po'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /phas kyi rgol ba'i dpung tshogs zil gyis gnon/ /mkhyen pa'i 'od zer kun nas rab rgyas pas/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa kun nas sel mdzad ma/ /rje btsun lha mo drag mo khyod la 'dud/ /gang thod gri gug zung gis thugs kar mdzes/ /ral gri ut+pal phyag mtshan 'dzin pa dang / /rab mdzes sngo ba'i mdog can spyan gsum ma/ /g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum stabs kyis mdzes par bzhugs/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong gnas shing / /lhag pa'i shes rab mi zad 'byin pa'i lha/ /rig gnas ma lus rig pa don gnyer bas/

/lhag par brten 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor yid la sems byed cing / /ngag gi rigs sngags rab tu bzla byed pa/ /kun nas kun tu mkhyen pa rgyas byed ma/ /gtsug gi nor bus gus pas 'dud par bgyid/ /gang la bstod tshig 'di yis bstod byed pa/ /spobs pa mi zad kun nas rgyas gyur cig /mkhas pa'i go 'phang myur du thob pa dang / /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs thob shog /ces sgrol ma u gra tā ra la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /nye ba'i sras brgyad la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi chu char g.yo ba'i sprin zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku sprin bral yongs su dag pa'i mkhar/ /mkhyen pa'i 'od can phyogs bral g.yo ba can/ /srid gsum mun pa ma lus rnam sel ba/ /thub dbang mchog la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad med thugs rjes nye bar kun bsdus shing / /rgyal ba kun gyi sras gyi thu bo pa/ /tshad med 'phrin las 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal/ /nye ba'i sras la dang bas bstod par bgyi/ /rab dkar dge tshogs gangs ri bzhu ba'i rgyun/ /gzhan phan chu bo bye ba rab rgyas pa/ /mtha' yas gdul bya'i snod du lhung gyur nas/ /sgrib gnyis dri ma dag byed nye bar 'dzin/ /yon tan rin chen rmad du byung ba'i sras/ /'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas chen po las/ /'gro ba 'don pa'i thabs la mkhas gyur cing / /mkhyen pa'i nyi ma mtha' yas 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /phrin las 'od zer so so rab spros pas/ /skye dgu'i tshogs rnams so sor thar mdzad cing / /thugs rje'i zhags pas mtha' yas zhing khams su/ /'gro rnams thar pa'i lam du khrid par mdzad/ /gdul bya dag pa'i chu yi snod yangs su/ /sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan cig char ston pa dang / /bsam las 'das pa'i yon tan grangs med pas/ /kun kyang rjes su 'dzin pa'i phrin las can/

/pad+mo rgyas pas dga' ba'i yid 'phrog bzhin/ /mthong ba tsam gyis kun dga'i dpal ster ba/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'khor ba'i 'dam nang nas/ /'dren pa'i phrin las rmad du byung gyur pa/ /cha shas yon tan brjod pa tsam gyis kyang / /bsam yas yon tan kun gyi snod gyur nas/ /byang chub chen po'i skal ba can mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi yon tan dpag tu med pa las/ /cung zad tsam zhig brjod pa'i dge ba yis/ /'gro rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho las brgal nas/ /bla med thar pa'i gling du bgrod par shog /ces nye ba'i sras brgyad la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das kyi nye ba'i sras mchog zung gcig la bstod pa snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku g.yo ba med kyang gzugs skur ston/ /brjod pa kun dang bral yang dam chos gsung / /'bad pa'i rtsol ba med kyang 'phrin las mdzad/ /skyob pa'i dbang po'i zhabs pad spyi bor 'dud/ /mchog gi yon tan ldan pa nye ba'i sras/ /gang de'i yon tan chu char dang mtshungs kyang / /bstod tshig pad+mo chu thigs dang 'dra bas/ /khyab par gyur pa rnam pa gnyis la bstod/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i shes rab phul phyin pas/ /lhag pa'i shes rab lhag pa'i yon tan brnyes/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab grangs med mtha' yas pas/ /skad cig gcig la 'dzin pa'i shes rab ldan/ /shes rab can zhes brjod pa ma nor zhing / /shes rab 'khor lor srid pa'i 'ching ba dag /ma lus bcad nas ye shes snang ba yis/ /srid pa'i mun pa ring du spong bar mdzad/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis stong gsum brgyad khri dag /skad cig gcig la bgrod pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / /ngo mtshar dpag med ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'gro ba dpag med bstan la 'god par mdzad/ /rab 'jigs rdzu 'phrul cher ldan pas/

/bdud kyi dpung tshogs kun 'joms shing / /legs tshogs thams cad 'byung ba'i gter/ /rdzu 'phrul che mchog khyod la 'dud/ /mchog gnyis yon tan cung zad brjod pa las/ /byung ba'i dge tshogs gang zhig thob pa yis/ /shes rab rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan zhing / /'gro kun bla med byang chub thob par shog /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dam pa'i chos yang dag par sdud pa po rnams la bstod pa phul du byung ba'i yon tan gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi spyan ldan kun la rmad byung mchog /dgra bcom nyon mongs kun spangs rnam grol thob/ /mchod 'os dam pa dgra bcom lnga brgya po/ /yang dag bsdu ba'i dpang por 'khod gyur cing / /mang du thos pa skye ba'i lcags sgrogs dag /gcod par byed pa 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ /chos mngon shes bya'i rgya mtsho bsdu byed pa/ /blo ldan 'phags pa 'od srungs bdag nyid che/ /rnam dag 'dul ba'i sdud byed nye ba 'khor/ /mi brjed gzungs thob 'du byed dam pa la/ /lha mi kun gyis dam chos nyi ma dag /nub pa'i dogs pas 'chi ba yid sos mdzad/ /mchod 'os bstod 'os mchog tu gyur pa yis/ /dam chos sdud byed rnams kyi yon tan dag /cung zad brjod pa'i bstod tshig me tog gis/ /mchod pa'i dge bas dam chos rgyas gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos nā len+d+rar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /gnas brtan chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku'i mkhar gnas gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor ston/ /tshad med thugs rje'i 'od kyi snang ba yis/ /ma lus 'jig rten khams kun khyab mdzad pa/ /skyob pa bla med thub dbang zhabs la 'dud/ /zag med dbyings las ye shes g.yo med gnas/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin brtas yi thugs mnga' ba/

/bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan dpag med ldan/ /gnas brtan chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /kun nas yid 'ong dang ba skye ba'i sku/ /gsung gi yan lag dam chos sgra sgrogs pa/ /mi rtog thugs ni nam mkha'i ngang tshul can/ /tshad med yon tan kun gyi gter la 'dud/ /rigs dang zhabs ldan skye dgu'i mchod pa'i gnas/ /nyon mongs med pa'i ting 'dzin mchog thob cing / /smon gnas mkhyen pas ma lus mngon sum mkhyen/ /skyes bu 'dul ba'i tshogs la dang bas 'dud/ /gsung rab rin chen sgrom gyi kha phye nas/ /bstan pa mi nyams yongs su bsrung bar mdzad/ /thub dbang bka' yi cod pan gtsug na 'dzin/ /ji srid bsod nams zhing gi dpal du gnas/ /zag zad phul phyin mkhyen pa dri med pa/ /dgra sngon bcom pa 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /rang rang cha lugs mdzes pa'i tshogs bsnams nas/ /gzi brjid phung po nyin byed dbang po bzhin/ /mi slob chos bcu dag la dbang 'byor pas/ /'khor tshogs kun kyang sa thob phul byung ba/ /rnam mang rgyu skar bkram ltar dbus na ni/ /zab yangs chos kyi sgra chen du ma sgrog /cung zad phul yang 'bras bu rgya chen dag /'phel bar 'gyur ba yon tan mchog gi gnas/ /khri dang drug stong bzhi brgya'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /mi bsnyel bstan pa bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzad/ /dpag med yon tan phung po 'di mthong nas/ /ngo mtshar blo yi rgyu skar dbang po yang / /blta ba'i slad du gling 'dir yang yang du/ /rgyu ba'i ngang tshul ston pa rmad du byung / /dang ba'i dad pa'i blo yis rab bskul nas/ /ri bo'i tshogs kyang mgo bo dud 'dra zhing / /rgya mtsho'i rlung gis bskyod pa'i rba rlabs kyang / /dad dang gus pas gyen du phyogs par byed/ /rab dkar thugs rje'i zla 'od mthong ba yis/ /skye dgu rnam mang sad pa'i blo thob nas/ /lag pa'i pad+mo snying khar zum byed cing / /ze 'bru'i dri bsung ci yang 'bul la rol/

/thub pas bsod nams zhing du rab bstod pa/ /gnas brtan chen po 'khor tshogs dgra bcom bcas/ /mchod cing gus pas rab tu bstod byed pa/ /rtag tu mtho ris dpal la longs spyod cing / /nges legs skal ba can du mdzad pa po/ /gnas brtan chen po 'khor tshogs bcas pa la/ /cung zad bstod pas ma gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /sa dang lam gyi rim pa rab bsgrod nas/ /bla med chos sku'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa 'di rong ston chen pos slar yang dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dgra bcom pa rnams la bstod pa phul du byung ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mkhyen ces brjod pa gsal bar grags/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba yongs su 'dzin/ /khyab bdag 'phrin las 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ /bcom ldan lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa'i ral gri yis/ /'ching ba bcad nas rnam par grol ba brnyes/ /srid pa'i mtha' las 'das pa'i mya 'das thob/ /sdug bsngal khur gyis ngal ba rab tu spangs/ /srid pa'i chu bo las brgal 'khor ba ru/ /mi zlog sa thob zag med bde ba ldan/ /'khor ba dgra tshogs sngon bcom dri med blo/ /zag zad phul phyin rigs gsum mngon sum mkhyen/ /bden bzhi rtogs pa'i bya ba mthar phyin zhing / /zhe sdang sgra gcan las grol bsil zer can/ /gti mug sprin tshogs mi gnas ring spangs zhing / /'dod chags rdul gyis ma gos dri ma med/ /zag pa kun zad spangs pa phun tshogs thob/ /rnam grol sku brnyes tshad med yon tan dang / /srid pa'i mtha' las 'das pa'i mngon shes kyi/ /mkhyen pa phul byung dri med yon tan ldan/ /shes pa bcu phrag sgrib med rab gsal cing / /bsam gtan rab mtha'i ting 'dzin brtan pa dang / /mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po lnga phrag la/ /mkhas pas blo gros lhag mthong mngon du gyur/ /'jig rten kun gyis mchod 'os dgra bcom tshogs/

/gus pas bstod pa'i tshad med dge tshogs kyis/ /thar pa bla na med pa thob gyur cig /tshad med 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /ces dgra bcom rnams la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi yon tan brjod pa tshogs gnyis la spro ba bskyed pa'i gtam zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla med byang chub mchog du bsgrod pa'i lam/ /tshogs gnyis ma lus yongs su sdud byed cing / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyi lam gcig pu/ /thar 'dod gdul bya rnams kyi 'jug ngogs che/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin yi dwags 'gro ba dang / /dbul ba 'dor zhing longs spyod mi zad gter/ /sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can rjes 'dzin zhing / /mngon mtho nges legs rgyur ni 'gyur ba yi/ /khrims kyis mi khom gnas rnams spong byed cing / /dal ba'i 'byor ba phun tshogs thob par 'gyur/ /lus ngag yid gsum dul ba dri med thob/ /mngon mtho'i rgyu yi gtso bor rab tu brtan/ /bzod pas ngan 'gro'i rgyun rnams gcod byed pas/ /bzod pa dang mtshungs dka' thub ma mchis shing / /khong khro spangs pas phyir mi ldog pa nyid/ /thob par 'gyur ba sangs rgyas zhal gyis bzhes/ /brtson pas dkar ba'i yon tan kun rgyas shing / /thar pa'i gnas su myur du phyin pa dang / /bsod nams blo gros tshogs ni gnyis kyi rgyu/ /bsam gtan gyis ni rnam par g.yeng ba zhi/ /bsgom bya'i don la sems ni rtse gcig 'gyur/ /bying rgod mtha' la mi gnas ting 'dzin thob/ /shes rab kyis ni chos rnams rab shes nas/ /dngos por 'dzin pa'i dgra tshogs rab bcom zhing / /sgrib gnyis mun tshogs ma lus bsal gyur te/ /khams gsum dag las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ /rgyal sras gang zhig byang chub don gnyer ba/ /pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan rgyas mdzad pas/ /gting zab 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal te/

/rgyal ba'i dbang po'i go 'phang thob par nges/ /chos la skyabs 'gro'i yul yang 'di nyid de/ /lam gyi bden pa'i mchog kyang 'di nyid do/ /'di la 'jug pas tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog thob par 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la rab bstod pa'i/ /dge tshogs rab dkar gang zhig thob pa des/ /dam chos yon tan phun tshogs rab brnyes nas/ /rnam mkhyen thar pa'i gling du bgrod par shog /ces pha rol phyin pa drug gi yon tan brjod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa thar pa'i sa 'dzin zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams rwa ba khor yug cher yangs par/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon pa rab rgyas te/ /pha rol phyin pa'i yal ga'i khyon yangs shing / /sku gsum 'bras bu'i khur ldan mchog la 'dud/ /chos 'khor gsum gyi snying po'i don 'dus pa/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi so sor thar pa las/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par bsgrub/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /de skad gsungs pa'i snying po'i don bsdus pa/ /bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa 'di/ /thar 'dod 'gro ba'i tshogs la bshad par bya/ /mi dge bcu spangs lus ngag dri med pa/ /sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pas rab bsgrubs nas/ /rmad du byung ba'i mtho ris dag gi don/ /legs par sgrub byed tshul khrims dag la bsngags/ /tshul khrims yang dag ting 'dzin rab tu gsal/ /rtse gcig ting 'dzin dag gis bsam gtan thob/ /sems ni rab zhi zhi ba bla med cing / /spyan dang mngon par shes pa'i yon tan thob/ /ting 'dzin ye shes ye shes rab tu gsal/ /thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab phul byung brnyes/ /stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong rab rgyas shing / /bslab gsum yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs par 'gyur/

/sangs rgyas gsung rab sde snod gsum du 'dus/ /dug gsum gnyen por sde snod gsum du gsungs/ /sde snod gsum gyi brjod bya'ang 'di nyid de/ /de phyir 'di la mchog tu bstod par 'os/ /gnad kyi snying po 'di nyid ma rtogs na/ /tshig gis spros pa'i ngal bas ci zhig bya/ /bslab gsum yon tan cung zad rab brjod pa'i/ /dge bas bla med byang chub myur thob shog /ces bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dag pa'i snang ba phyogs med du rgyas pa 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po 'phrog byed cing / /mkhyen pa'i yon tan stobs kyi mngon mtho ba/ /man ngag stobs kyis rtogs pa'i yon tan brnyes/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi bla ma kun la 'dud/ /byin rlabs gzi brjid 'od stong 'bar ba yis/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /gzhung lugs rab mkhas legs bshad bdud rtsi yis/ /blo gros rab tu rgyas pa'i rgyud 'dzin dang / /zab don man ngag nyams su blangs pa las/ /rmad byung ting 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /sems rgyud rnam dag sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin pa/ /tshad med yon tan mnga' ba de dag kun/ /yon gnas dam pa cung zad phul yang ni/ /'bras bu rgya chen dag tu 'gyur ba ste/ kun gyi mchod 'os rnam pa kun tu ni/ /bdag nyid shin tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan du ma'i dpal gyi mngon mtho ba/ /gdul bya'i 'dren pa mchog du gnas pa yi/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi bla ma dam pa rnams/ /rab tu dang ba'i blo yis yang dag bstod/ /bstod tshig me tog snyim pas legs mchod cing / /lus ngag yid kyi nyes pa'i skyon rnams bshags/ /dus gsum 'gro ba'i dge la rje yi rang / /rgyal rnams chos 'khor bskor dang rtag par bzhugs/ /dge ba 'di yis ma lus mngon sum mkhyen/

/thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di rong ston chen pos nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /rmad du byung ba'i gtam zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i skyob pa mchog gyur pa/ /mkhas grub rgya mtsho yongs su gang ba'i gnas/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /bka' dang bstan bcos mi 'jigs smra ba po/ /mkhas pa mi yi seṅges bsten pa'i gnas/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i stobs mnga' ba/ /rgyun gyis dbang po 'di yang brtan gyur cig /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 'khod pa rnams su yang / /dam chos smra ba du ma'i gnas gyur pa/ /'bad pas mngon par 'dus byas gang yin pa'i/ /gtsug lag khang rnams rtag tu rgyas cig /bstan srung kun kyang mthu stobs dang ldan zhing / /'jam dpal dbyangs dang 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / /rdo rje 'dzin sogs dag gi byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag gi smon lam ji bzhin 'grub par shog /ces rmad du byung ba'i smon lam gyi gtam zhes bya ba/ rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /ni gu chos drug gi brgyud pa rin chen rnam bdun la bstod pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku 'gag med nam mkha' yangs pa'i mkhar/ /gzugs sku nyin byed dkyil 'khor rab rgyas te/ /phrin las 'od kyis 'gro ba'i mun sel ba/ /brgyud pa rin chen rnam bdun la phyag 'tshal/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi yis/ /nyon mongs rims nad rab tu spong mdzad cing / /zag med bde ba'i dga' ston rnam rol ba/ /dri med gdams pa'i ngag gis zlos gar bsgyur/ /gtum mo'i me yis nyon mongs bud shing bsregs/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku yi go 'phang brnyes/ /rmi lam 'khrul pa chos dbyings ngang la thim/ /'od gsal stobs kyis ma rig tshogs kun sel/

/dag pa'i zhing du thogs med rab bgrod pa'i/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i dmigs pa phun tshogs shing / /bar dor rgyal ba longs sku mngon du gyur/ /bla ma rin chen rnam bdun gus pas bstod/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba rnams/ /bla med bla ma dam pa mnyes gyur cig /ces brgyud pa rin chen rnam bdun la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal na len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /nā ro chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la bstod pa byin rlabs gnad kyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mu mtha' yas pa'i dge tshogs dpag med las/ /legs par 'ongs pa'i tshad med yon tan 'od/ /phyogs bcur rab rgyas ma rig mun pa sel/ /rig 'dzin sa brnyes byin rlabs 'od stong 'bar/ /zab mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i stobs rgyas shing / /zab mo'i chos drug rig pa'i spyan dang ldan/ /zab mo'i ting 'dzin mi rtog rdo rje'i thugs/ /mngon shes drug ldan rigs gsum mngon du gyur/ /phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / /dga' bzhi'i ting 'dzin zag med bde ba rgyas/ /stobs bzhi'i stobs kyis bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs 'joms/ /tshad med bzhi ldan brtse ba'i bdag nyid can/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bos mi shis dri ma dag /yid kyi gangs rir byin rlabs chu bo 'bab/ /gang la man ngag bdud rtsi gang thob pa/ /skye gnas bzhi las 'gro ba sgrol bar mdzad/ /gang la gus pas bstod pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas/ /bde chen thar pa'i gling du phyin pa dang / /bka' brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug 'gyur cig /ces nā ro chos drug gi bla ma rnams la bstod pa/ rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /zhi byed brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la bstod pa rmad du byung ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/

/bsam yas bskal par legs tshogs smin pa'i mthus/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin rtogs pa'i dpal mnga' zhing / /rnam dag brgyud pa'i dam chos sna tshogs kyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro la phan bde'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /bden pa'i don gzigs ye shes spyan mnga' zhing / /sa yi dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ /byang chub sems kyi snying stobs rab rgyas pas/ /tshad med 'gro la brtse ba'i bdag nyid can/ /rmad byung man ngag bdud rtsi rab rgyas pa/ /cha shas gang gi rna bar lhung ba yis/ /phun tshogs rtogs pa skye ba'i mchog 'gyur zhing / /sdug bsngal ma lus zhi byed bde ba thob/ /byin rlabs chu rgyun rim par legs brgyud pa'i/ /dam pa rnams kyi srol 'dzin mchog gyur cing / /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa thob 'ba' zhig pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas mchog tu gyur/ /rje btsun rgya gar zhabs las legs brgyud pa'i/ /rnam dag rgyud sde kun gyi bcud 'thungs pas/ /rtogs pa'i bdud rtsis rim par rgyud gang ba'i/ /zhi byed brgyud pa'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /gang la gus pas 'dud pa tsam gyis kyang / /bla med byang chub mchog du nges mdzad pa/ /dam pa rnams la gus pas rab bstod pa'i/ /dge tshogs byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dam chos mngon pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la bstod pa blo gros kyi pad+mo rgyas par byed pa'i nyi ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med kyang ste/ /sna tshogs zhing du sprul pa'i skur ston cing / /phrin las 'od zer phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas/ /'gro ba'i don byed thub dbang zhabs la 'dud/ /yang dag snang bas ma rig mun sel ba/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa dam chos mngon pa'i mdo/ /mchog tu gsal mdzad thogs med dbyig gnyen sogs/ /chos mngon smra ba'i nyi ma de la 'dud/

/'jam dpal dbyangs kyi mkhyen rab 'dzin byed pa/ /rgyal po'i sras dang slob dpon gang ba spel/ /gnad kyi sgron me mdzad pa'i mkhyen rab can/ /gzhan yang chos mngon smra ba rnams la 'dud/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir chos mngon rgyas mdzad pa/ /chos kyi brtson 'grus ye shes 'byung gnas dang / /brang ti dar ma snying po la sogs pa/ /smra ba'i seng ge mkhas pa'i tshogs la 'dud/ /'khor ba bskyed mdzad nyon mongs dug gsum ste/ /rtsa ba ma rig yongs su spong mdzad pa/ /shes rab bslab pa rgyud la dbang ba ste/ /nyon mongs dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur cig /chos mngon smra ba gus pas rab bstod pa'i/ /dge tshogs gang gis ma rig mun bsal ste/ /blo gros snang ba kun nas rgyas gyur pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces dam chos mngon pa'i brgyud pa la bstod pa 'di rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+rar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan la bstod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khor yug rdo rje rwa bas legs bskor zhing / /phyogs su rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi rtsibs/ /gtsug lag khang bzang bkod pas rab tu mdzes/ /so so'i nang du byin rlabs gzi brjid can/ /lha tshogs bye ba'i rgyu skar rab tu bkram/ /yid 'ong gyen du 'phags pa'i gan+dho la/ /dbus su byin rlabs rab 'bar byang chub shing / /yal gi khyon yangs lo 'dab rab tu rgyas/ /lha lnga'i bdag nyid yal ga lnga pa can/ /gyen du 'thon pa mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / /dang ba'i dad pa sngon med skye ba dang / /rmad byung dri zhim phyogs rnams kun la khyab/ /byang chub chen po yid 'ong 'ja' tshon sku/ /byang chub shing la brten pa shar phyogs su/ /rnam par gzigs pa'i gzi 'od rab 'bar bas/ /'gro ba dpag med bde la 'god par mdzad/ /mngon par byang chub tshul bstan bdud dpung gis/

/'phangs pa'i mtshon cha me tog char par gyur/ /mkha' la skya rengs 'char ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /ting 'dzin stobs kyis sgrib gnyis pham mdzad nas/ /mngon par byang chub smin mtshams mdzod spu las/ /'od zer spros pas 'jig rten snang mdzad cing / /byang chub tshul bstan ngo mtshar rdo rje'i gdan/ /rdzogs sangs gang du bltams dang gnas la 'dud/ /gang gi gnas la phyag 'tshal bsod nams dag /dpag med bshad pa'i rjes su legs 'brangs nas/ /mngon par byang chub bstan pa'i gnas mchog la/ /bstod pa'i dge bas byang chub gnas thob shog /ces rdo rje gdan la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /shrī nā len+d+ra la bstod pa snyan pa'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal bas lung bstan ngo mtshar dpag med gnas/ /yon tan rmad byung mi zad 'byung ba'i gter/ /mkhas pa du ma'i zhabs kyi rten gyur pa/ /nā len+d+ra zhes bya ba'i gnas la bstod/ /dam chos 'chad pa rgyu skar phreng ba bzhin/ /paṇa chen mkhas pa'i mchog gyur brgya phrag lnga/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po bcu phrag bdun/ /rab tu grags pa ngo mtshar du ma'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rab tu gsal byed pa/ /mkhas pa mtha' yas 'jigs med seng ge'i sgra/ /rab tu sgrogs pa gzi brjid 'bar ba can/ /dam chos 'chad pa'i khri la rnam par mdzes/ /mi slob zung 'jug brnyes pa'i sa ra ha/ /'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus na ri dbang bzhin/ /klu sgrub dang ni thogs med dbyig gnyen dang / /phyogs glang chos kyi grags pa rnams kyi gnas/ /nā len+d+ra yi rdzing khar 'od dpag med/ /thugs rje chen po mdzub ker la sogs pa/ /rten mchog ngo mtshar dpag med bzhugs zhes grags/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan gyis bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /'di la bstod pa'i dge tshogs dri med pa/ ston ka'i zla ltar gang zhig thob pa des/ /srid pa'i mun pa ma lus rnam bsal te/

/ye shes snang ba kun tu rgyas par shog /ces rgya gar nā len+d+ra'i gnas la bstod pa rong ston chen pos gangs can gyi khrod kyi nā len+d+rar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la bstod pa snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog la/ /bstod pa tsam gyis bsod nams dpag med dag /thob par 'gyur zhes bshad pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /dam chos gsungs pa'i gnas la bstod par bgyi/ /rgyal bas legs gsungs bka' yi bsdu ba'i gnas/ /lag mthil ltar mnyam bkra shis phun tshogs ldan/ /ri phran du mas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus/ /rgyal po'i khab ces bya ba'i grong khyer gyi/ /shar gyi phyogs su mngon par mtho ba'i ri/ /nyi ma bzhin du gzi brjid phun tshogs ldan/ /sa 'dzin ngogs rnams nags tshal stug pos 'khrigs/ /ljon shing yid 'ong lo 'dab gsar pa can/ /kha dog sna tshogs me tog thod bcings nas/ /snyan pa'i sgra 'byin bya tshogs mang po dag /yal ga'i phyogs su phan tshun 'phur lding byed/ /'dzam gling ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas lnga las/ /mchog tu gyur pa bya rgod phung po'i ri/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyis bstod byed pa/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas/ /dpag med byin rlabs gzi brjid 'bar ba can/ /lam phran bstan zhes bya ba'i gnas brtan la/ /dgra bcom stong dang drug brgyas bskor ba bzhugs/ /gang gis 'di ni mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / /dang ba'i dad pa lhun gyis grub pa 'byung / /dpag yas lha tshogs du ma 'dus pa'i gnas/ /rgyal bas sher phyin 'brug gi sgra dbyangs bsgrags/ /gdul bya du ma bden pa mthong ba la/ /bkod pa'i gnas mchog ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /legs gsungs nyan pa'i slad du rgyal sras rnams/ /nye bar lhags nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /gnas mchog 'di la bstod pa'i dge tshogs kyis/

/sangs rgyas zhing du thogs med bgrod par shog /ces bya rgod phung po'i ri la bstod pa rong ston chen pos nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dga' ldan gyi lha gnas la bstod pa phul du byung ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ rgyal ba mi pham pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab bzhugs pa ngo mtshar gnas/ /gang la bgrod pa dga' bde'i phan yon gyis/ /mngon par rol pa dam pa dpag med pa/ /chos kyi dga' bde'i rol pas gnas byed cing / /lha gnas gzhan las chos kyi dga' char gyis/ /phul du byung bas kun gyis bstod pa'i gzhi/ /gang gi gnas su skyes pa'i skye bo dag /theg chen chos kyi dga' bas rnam par rol/ /srid las 'phags pa'i yon tan phun tshogs brnyes/ /gang du skye ba'i smon lam 'debs byed pa/ /thar pa'i skal ba can du byed pa yi/ /gnas mchog dam pa de la gus pas bstod/ /bstod pa'i dge bas dga' ldan lha gnas su/ /'gro kun shi 'phos thag tu skye bar shog /ces dga' ldan lha gnas la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la bstod pa phul du byung ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes ba/ 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen rab bdag nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis/ /yongs su brten pa'i gnas mchog phul byung ba/ /dam pa rnams kyis bstod pa'i gnas gyur cing / /gang du bgrod pa de yang shes rab ldan/ /byin rlabs sna tshogs 'byung ba'i mtshan ma dag /rab yangs mkha' la 'ja' tshon ri mo mthong / /gzugs sogs phung po lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /sku lnga'i ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /rtse lnga'i ri bo mngon par mtho ba dang / /phyogs mtshams rnams su lha yi khang bzang dag /yid 'ong rgyu skar 'phreng ltar rab bkra zhing / /gnas kyi phan yon 'dod pa'i skye bo dag /pad+ma'i mtsho la bung ba'i tshogs bzhin du/ /dad ldan skye bo yid la 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /byin rlabs mtshan ma dpag med 'byung zhes pas/

/de phyir gnas mchog de la kun gyis bstod/ /bstod pa'i dge ba rmad byung grub pa yis/ /dag pa'i zhing du thogs med bgrod par shog /ces rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bzhugs gnas ri bo gru 'dzin la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje'i me tog dkar po rgyas pa'i dbus/ /byin rlabs 'od zer dkar ba'i mdangs 'phrog pa/ /nyams thag 'gro ba mang po rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gang zhig bgrod pa tsam gyi tshad med kyi/ /rab dkar snying rje dpag med skye 'gyur zhing / /bkra shis yid 'ong ri mo mdzes pa dang / /phyogs rnams kun tu skyed tshal 'bras bu can/ /lo 'dab gsar pa du mas mdzes byas shing / /dri zhim yid 'ong me tog rnam par rgyas/ /ro mngar ldan pa'i 'bras bu'i khur gyis brjid/ /ljon shing bye ba'i ngogs su rnam par 'khrigs/ /mdzes pa'i bya tshogs mang po rnam par rgyu/ /mthong ba tsam gyis yid la spro ba skye/ /ngo mtshar thugs rje'i 'byung gnas dpal dang ldan/ /gnas mchog gzhan las yid 'dzin spro ba 'phel/ /lha mchog rjes su dran pa'i blo gros kyis/ /de las byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug 'gyur zhing / /de phyir spyan ras gzigs dbang gnas la bstod/ /bstod pa'i dge bas zhing der bgrod gyur cig /ces ri bo gru 'dzin la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+rar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal gur gyi mgon po la bstod pa rngam pa sgra sgrogs ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /char sprin dbus na 'jigs pa'i skur ston cing / /glog 'phreng 'khyug pa'i spyan gsum rnam par g.yo/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bstan pa skyong bar mdzad/ /gri gug thod pa thabs shes zung du sbrel/

/chu gter dbus na ri rab lhun po bzhin/ /gzi brjid phung po mthu stobs dpag tu med/ /nyin byed 'od kyis skar ma'i tshogs bzhin du/ /mi mthun bdud dpung tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon/ /zhabs kyi gom pa bskyod pas mtha' yas shing / /rgya mtsho chen po rlung gis bskyod pa ltar/ /sdig mdzub gdong nyid yongs su bstan pa'i tshe/ /lhun po'ang g.yo ba med par sdod dam snyam/ /zad pa'i dus kyi me lce 'bar ba yang / /zhal kyis dbugs cig btab pas rab tu zhi/ /drag po'i mche ba 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'debs par gzas pa bzhin/ /'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs rab tu sgrogs pa las/ /mthu stobs rlom pa'i gnod byed tshogs rnams kyang / /nye bar dmigs nas phyogs bcur byer ba dang / /gang la skyabs gsol de kun bsrung bar mdzad/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bskyod pa'i 'od/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od zer 'phrog par byed/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor drag por bskyod pa yis/ /ma lus 'jig rten khams kyang rab tu g.yo/ /'gran pa'i zla med gur gyi mgon po la/ /bstod pa'i dge bas mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /rab tu zhi zhing thugs bstan rgyas pa dang / /sgrub pa po rnams yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod/ /ces dpal gur gyi mgon po la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal gdong bzhi pa la bstod pa rmad du byung ba'i sgra sgrogs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan srung dam pa 'jigs pa'i gzugs 'chang ba/ /mi 'jigs mthu ldan pha rol zil gyis gnon/ /zhing khams kun tu dgyes pa'i gar bsgyur zhing / /'jigs pa'i gad mos stong gsum mtha' dag g.yo/ /dbus zhal rab 'jigs mche ba 'jigs pa ston/ /g.yas g.yon glang chen dang ni ma he'i zhal/ /rgyab zhal seṅge'i gdong pa spyan gsum dmar/ /kun tu gzigs pas gdon dang bgegs rnams 'joms/

/ma lus dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad phyir/ /rab mdzes mtshon cha du ma 'dzin pa dang / /rnal 'byor nyon mongs tshogs kun bsreg bya'i phyir/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /'jigs byed chen po gdong bzhi ldan pa la/ /'jigs rung yum chen drag mo bzhi yis bskor/ /'jigs mdzad sprul pa'i pho nya du ma 'gyed/ /'jigs pa'ang 'jigs rung 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /gang la bstod tshig cung zad bgyis pa 'dis/ /bstod pas mnyes pa'i dga' char 'bebs gyur cig /ces dpal gdong bzhi pa la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /mgon po a gho ra la bstod pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan skyong chen po gzi brjid phung po can/ /thun mtshams sprin gyis dmar ba'i mdangs 'phrog cing / /smin mtshams dbus su nyi zla'i gzi 'od 'bar/ /me dang dur khrod 'jigs rung dbus na bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas bdud rnams ma lus sdigs byed pa/ /tsan+dan beng chen sgeg pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin/ /g.yon pa zhi byed sman gyi gang bu bsnams/ /yid 'ong ber gyi na bza' sku la gsol/ /bka' sdod nag po dpal ldan lha mor bcas/ /'khor tshogs phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad pa/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ /rab gus dang ba'i yid kyis bstod par bgyi/ /yongs su bstod pa kun nas mnyes gyur cing / /rnal 'byor pa la dngos grub mchog stsol cig /ces mgon po a gho ra la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /mgon po phyag drug pa la bstod pa dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can bstan pa srung mdzad pa/ /me lce rab tu 'bar bas bdud dpung bsregs/ /glog 'od 'khyug 'dra'i spyan gsum rab 'bar bas/ /phas rgol bdud sde'i dpung tshogs 'joms par byed/

/baiḍūr+ya yi phung po brtsegs pa bzhin/ /gnod sbyin pho mo'i steng na 'gying bag can/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa dang / /thod pa'i phreng ba do shal rgyan du byas/ /gzi brjid phung pos las kun sgrub byed pa/ /'khor tshogs du ma'i dbus na mngon mtho zhing / /thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyi sprul pa mchog /myur mdzad nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rmad byung dam can khyod la bstod pa yis/ /rnal 'byor can gyi bar chad zhi ba dang / /dngos grub kun stsol thub bstan rgyas pa yis/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba 'phel bar shog /ces phyag drug pa la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dkar mo nyi zla la bstod pa mi 'jigs pa'i gter zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid 'ong zla ba'i 'od ni 'phrog byed cing / /rab dkar gangs ri phung po brtsegs 'dra ba/ /phyag g.yas ri dbang lhun po 'dzin pa dang / /g.yon pas gling bzhi thur la bzlog pa bsnams/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis rnam mang rgyu skar bzhin/ /mi mthun bdud kyi dpung rnams zil gyis gnon/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas mdzes byas shing / /nyi zla stong gi phreng bas rgyan du byas/ /spyi bor nyi zla'i 'od zer stong 'bar bas/ /sprul pa dpag med 'gyed pa'i mthu dang ldan/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig can rnams skyong mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /gang la bstod pa'i me tog phul ba yis/ /phyogs dus kun tu dge legs 'byung bar mdzod/ /ces bstan srung dkar mo nyi zla la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /pu tra lcam sring gsum la bstod pa snyan pa'i rnga chen zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs las legs 'khrungs shing / /phan bde las rnams bsgrub la brtson mdzad pa/ /myur mgyogs drag po'i las la rngam pa yis/

/rnam dag zhing du dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor can la nye ba'i thugs mnga' ba/ /dam pas bka' bsgos bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan 'byung po'i gnod pa 'joms/ /bar chad zhi ba'i las kun bsgrub byed pa'i/ /bka' srung lcam sring rnams la rab tu bstod/ /khyod la bstod tshig yid 'ong phul ba yis/ /rnam pa kun tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang / /thos bsam sgom pa kun tu 'phel bar mdzod/ /ces pu tra ming sring la bstod pa rong ston chen pos sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal bdud rgyal thod phreng la bstod pa mthu stobs bskyed byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phas rgol zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu ldan zhing / /rab 'jigs thod pa'i phreng ba rgyan du byas/ /myur mgyogs rngam pa rta pa'i dpung tshogs can/ /rnal 'byor bar chad bzlog pa'i mthu bo che/ /dam pas bsngags pa'i lam la rab brtson zhing / /mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang stobs po che/ /rno ba'i mtshon thogs khro ba'i bzhin mdangs can/ /bstan srung drag po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun/ /nye bar mi gnas ring du mthar byed la/ /rab tu bstod pa'i mthu las chos grwa 'di'i/ /mthun rkyen kun sgrub 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /ces bdud rgyal thod phreng can la bstod pa rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa la bstod pa rnam rgyal ba'i bstod dbyangs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan srung dam pa gzi brjid phung po can/ /phyogs su rab rgyas rnam bzhi'i phyag ldan pa/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa can/ /ma lus dgra bgegs mthar byed khyod la 'dud/ /bsil ba'i tshal na klu sgrub snying po yis/ /gus pas spyan drangs rkang brgyad tshig gis bstod/ /bstan pa mi nyams yongs su bsrung mdzad pa/

/kun las rnam rgyal bdud kyi bdud la bstod/ /mtha' yas zhing skyong dbus na mngon par mtho/ /rnal 'byor can la dngos grub ster mdzad cing / /mi mthun phyogs kun 'joms pa'i mdzad pa can/ /bstan srung dam pa khyod la rab tu bstod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyis/ /mi mthun phyogs kun rab tu zhi ba dang / /mthun pa'i rkyen rnams lhun gyis grub pa dang / /thub bstan rgyas pa'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /ces ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa la bstod pa rnam par rgyal ba'i bstod dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di rong ston chen pos dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 66 rong ston/ rong ston gsung thor bu las bstod tshogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
